news.title: Watch live: Trump holds G7 press conference amid Iran deal blowback
news.summary: President Trump will hold a press conference Wednesday before departing France, where he has been attending the G7 summit this week. Trump will face questions about the memorandum of understanding (MOU) to end the Iran war, a 14-point plan that is facing intense pushback from his own allies.
